description.ko: Task CPU 카탈로그 59개와 구조적 소유권을 지키기 위한 구현 순서. 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다.
description.en: All 59 Task CPU catalog rows and the prerequisites for structured ownership; not an implementation claim.

native_foundation.current_contract: One native worker per task; gated prepare/commit/abort, terminal snapshot, cooperative requests, join/wait/timeout, terminal-only nonblocking try_take and global drain. Native structured Scope closes admission, drains all accepted children independently of discarded result observations, retries reap failure, and guards reentrant close. Independent native CancellationSource/Token roles retain small notification state after Task/Scope cleanup; new/clone/derivation are explicitly fallible. Source CancellationSource/Token and five cancellation aliases now have sealed, fallible bindings and local execution/safety gates. Generic worker Task<T>, source TaskScope, hierarchy, waits, executors and async remain separate obligations.
native_foundation.review_boundary: Read-only audit found and fixed discarded-handle entry reuse and concurrent report ordering. Runtime task reports Scope589 checks, Task865 checks plus100 cancellation races, and cancellation1370 checks plus4000 clone/query/release iterations and200 derivation/cleanup races, including sanitizer runs. Static Windows linking is not execution. These native checks do not establish source Task, Send/Sync permissions, JIT lifetime, hierarchy, waits or async.

implementation_order.goal: Sealed typed Task<T> owner and explicit lifecycle errors
requirements: Never expose the raw runtime token or context pointer to source. Constructors, initialized-result state, consuming join and nullable/Consumed state are compiler-managed.
T remains the actual application result type: Task<Result<U,E>> joins to Result<Result<U,E>,TaskError>; no implicit flattening or automatic E conversion.

On native success/cancellation/failure, consume the native token exactly once. NotReady preserves it; validation/reap errors preserve the native owner. Source error handling must keep or safely drain that ownership obligation.

Source Task Drop must either synchronously wait/drain or transfer its obligation to a live structured scope; it cannot silently retire a running borrowed task. A blocking-drop profile must say so explicitly and must not pretend to implement nonblocking discard_result.

implementation_order.goal: Real structured scope registry before borrowed spawn or result abandonment
requirements: Register every accepted child before commit/scheduling. Allocation or admission failure must leave no untracked worker; destroy unstarted owned captures exactly once or preserve input handles where the catalog requires.

TaskScope owns the drain obligation independently of result handles. close_scope closes admission, joins all children, releases all scoped loans and reports lifecycle failures; global process drain is not a substitute.

Borrowed captures, result handles and error carriers may not outlive their lexical source owners or scope. Scope/child lifetimes require compiler provenance, including early returns and nested scopes.

Nonblocking discard_result may discard result observation only after scope ownership is retained. The native Scope backend now implements that tracking; source capabilities and lexical loan release still require compiler integration.

implementation_order.goal: Safe work transfer and one-shot result access
requirements: spawn_owned moves F implementing FnOnce<Tuple<>,T>; repeatable Fn is not required. Captures/result/destructors need valid transfer permissions for native-thread execution.

Reject non-Send guards, thread-affine native owners and short-lived captures on migrating workers; owning a value alone does not prove Send. Shared/Weak permissions must follow actual Send/Sync checks.
try_take is a true nonblocking take: NotReady -> Ok(None), terminal success -> Ok(Some(T)) and mark handle Consumed; terminal lifecycle errors consume only after the runtime says so.
wait_timeout observes readiness; timeout neither cancels nor ends capture use or loans. cancel_and_join requests then returns actual completion, including races won by successful work.
CancellationToken must retain notification state after the source/task handle is gone. The native TaskContext pointer is valid only during invoke and cannot serve as a returned token.
CancellationSource has request authority; CancellationToken is a retained readonly observer. Cloning shares state; cancel_child propagates parent requests only downward.
Requests are cooperative and do not prove worker completion or release captures. check_cancel returns a typed Cancelled value; no forced thread termination.

The catalog cancel_token/cancel_clone return values are nonfallible, while Shared clone/retain currently reports RefCountError. Reconcile overflow/retain policy explicitly; do not erase a recoverable refcount error or silently claim the same source signature.
join_all and join_pair must wait every child even after an earlier failure; output allocation failure must preserve structured tracking.
map/then scheduling failure preserves the consumed input handle in SpawnInputError<Task<T>>. Mapper execution starts only after the input cleanup/result-take boundary.
JoinSet membership belongs to a compatible live scope; dropping the group does not detach or untrack children.
race is nonempty and returns owned handles for unfinished losers. It may not drop losers, force-cancel them, or return an outcome while abandoning their lifetime obligations.

implementation_order.goal: Executors, local work, timers and suspension
requirements: ExecutorId is scheduler identity, not OS thread id. A one-thread-per-task native backend is not a blocking pool or a local executor.
spawn_local/local_scope require execution on a compatible local executor without moving non-Send captures to the native worker backend.
Awaitable-returning APIs need actual suspension/wake/timer integration. A blocking join/sleep wrapped in an Awaitable name does not implement the catalog contract.
deadline_after uses checked monotonic time. sleep/yield_now need scheduler semantics; shutdown closes admission and drains without forced release of borrowed work.

implementation_order.goal: Explicit detach and capture diagnostics only after ownership infrastructure
requirements: detach permits independently owned/static-valid captures only and transfers the scope obligation to a retained detached registry. Failure must return the original Task<T>.
Terminal-only native pthread_detach/CloseHandle in try_take is OS metadata auto-reaping after all language work; it is not source-level Task.detach.
validate_captures is a compiler diagnostic/reporting facility and cannot be a runtime cast, Send bypass or lifetime validator.

must_reject_until_supported: Borrowed/thread-affine work on native workers without precise transfer and lifetime proofs.
A scoped Task/error/JoinSet/awaitable escaping its source storage or a scope closing while accepted work remains untracked.
await_result/await_timeout/await_scope/await_cancel/join_next/drain/wait_deadline/sleep/yield_now/cancel_scope_and_wait as suspension APIs without an executor/state machine/wake mechanism.
spawn_local/local_scope implemented by the migrating native-thread backend.
discard_result as a nonblocking operation without retained scope tracking; substituting blocking cleanup silently changes its contract.
detach for borrowed captures or by merely returning a raw token; terminal OS auto-reaping is not source detach.
Borrowing T from observe/status, taking T twice, aliasing a mutable take, or treating cancellation request/timeout as completed cleanup.
Returning TaskError after losing a still-running native owner on a reap failure unless an existing scope retains/drains the obligation.
Returning an escaping TaskContext pointer as CancellationToken, manufacturing ExecutorId from worker id, or returning success for unimplemented scheduling/diagnostic facilities.
required_gates: Exact capture/result Drop on success, pre-invoke cancellation, in-flight cancellation, failed registration, failed reap, unclaimed result and consumed state.
Custom Drop and reference-containing captures/results; no short-lived local escapes, owner mutation while work may use loans, nested-scope and early-return drains.
Guard/thread-affinity negatives, unsupported Send/Sync types, self-join and incompatible executor contexts.
Try-take nonblocking tail test, timeout keeps live work, cancellation race permits normal completion, every group child drained, race loser handles preserved.
Deterministic allocation/thread-creation/reap failures, source check/AOT/JIT O0/O2, AIR malformed-operation rejection and per-claimed-target execution.

catalog.name: Task.active_count
catalog.contract: Snapshot of registered unfinished children; not a standalone synchronization proof. | O(1) or registry query.

catalog.name: Task.await_cancel
catalog.contract: Resolves once a request is visible; does not wait for task cleanup. | Wake registration/suspension.

catalog.name: Task.await_result
catalog.contract: Suspends host computation; exclusive result take; lifetime of wait object retains scope obligations. | Scheduling/suspension cost; not a GPU command.

catalog.name: Task.await_scope
catalog.contract: Requires admission closed; drains all children and releases scoped loans before returning. | Suspends; may never complete for noncooperative work.

catalog.name: Task.await_timeout
catalog.contract: Suspending timeout observation; timed-out work remains registered and running. | Timer/scheduler overhead.

catalog.name: Task.cancel_and_join
catalog.contract: Requests then joins actual outcome; normal completion can win the race. | May wait indefinitely.

catalog.name: Task.cancel_child
catalog.contract: New child state receives parent propagation; child request does not affect parent. | May allocate/register.

catalog.name: Task.cancel_clone
catalog.contract: Retained observer of the same request state, not a new independent child. | O(1) retain.

catalog.name: Task.cancel_request
catalog.contract: Idempotent request; reports newly-requested or already-requested state. | Notification/propagation cost.

catalog.name: Task.cancel_requested
catalog.contract: Synchronized request snapshot; no completion guarantee. | O(1).

catalog.name: Task.cancel_scope_and_wait
catalog.contract: Closes admission, requests cancellation, drains all accepted children. | May wait indefinitely.

catalog.name: Task.cancel_source
catalog.contract: Creates independent unrequested state. | May allocate.

catalog.name: Task.cancel_token
catalog.contract: Retained read-only notification capability; source lifetime alone is not required afterward. | O(1) state retain.

catalog.name: Task.cancellation
catalog.contract: Returns retained read-only cancellation notification capability. | Reference-count/state retention cost.

catalog.name: Task.check_cancel
catalog.contract: Cooperative checkpoint; reports a request without killing task or releasing captures. | O(1).

catalog.name: Task.close_admission
catalog.contract: Stops new accepted registrations; existing work remains live. | O(1) synchronized transition.

catalog.name: Task.close_scope
catalog.contract: Stops admission, joins accepted children, releases loans before return; report retains unobserved lifecycle failures. | May wait indefinitely; no implicit detach.

catalog.name: Task.deadline_after
catalog.contract: Checked monotonic deadline computation; no wall-clock dependency. | O(1).

catalog.name: Task.detach
catalog.contract: Only independently owned/static-valid captures; failure returns original handle; runtime retains lifetime obligations. | Explicit scope transfer; detached runtime registry.

catalog.name: Task.discard_result
catalog.contract: Abandons result observation; scope still tracks work, failures and resource cleanup. | Nonblocking; destructor not sole tracker.

catalog.name: Task.drain
catalog.contract: Collects every registered group result before returning; scope obligations remain tracked on allocation error. | O(tasks); output allocation.

catalog.name: Task.executor
catalog.contract: Scheduler identity or local executor binding; not current worker-thread identity. | O(1).

catalog.name: Task.failed
catalog.contract: Creates tracked terminal lifecycle failure; does not encode an application E automatically. | State allocation may fail.

catalog.name: Task.id
catalog.contract: Stable identity during task state lifetime; not an OS thread ID. | O(1).

catalog.name: Task.insert
catalog.contract: Requires same compatible scope and no result take; error preserves handle. | Registration/bookkeeping cost.

catalog.name: Task.is_cancel_requested
catalog.contract: Snapshot of request flag, independent of success/finished state. | O(1).

catalog.name: Task.is_finished
catalog.contract: True only once required task-local cleanup/captured loan use is complete; not a success test. | O(1); no waiting.

catalog.name: Task.join
catalog.contract: Consumes result handle, waits to terminal state and transfers the result exactly once. | Blocking wait; forbidden on incompatible executor context.

catalog.name: Task.join_all
catalog.contract: Waits for every task and returns outcomes in input order; no fail-fast child abandonment. | O(tasks); allocates result vector.

catalog.name: Task.join_detached
catalog.contract: Observes detached terminal lifecycle and cleanup; result T was discarded by detach policy. | May wait; no ownership recovery of T.

catalog.name: Task.join_next
catalog.contract: Returns one completed task outcome; absence only when admission/group membership exhausted. | Suspends; removes one result.

catalog.name: Task.join_pair
catalog.contract: Waits both children regardless of one failing. | May block; fixed tuple output.

catalog.name: Task.join_set
catalog.contract: Creates result grouping tied to existing scope; dropping group does not untrack its tasks. | Allocates grouping state.

catalog.name: Task.local_scope
catalog.contract: Scope and children stay on same local executor; borrowed data still cannot escape. | Scheduling and drain costs.

catalog.name: Task.map
catalog.signature: Task.map<T, U>(&TaskScope scope, Task<T> input, Mapper<T, U> function)
catalog.contract: Tracks input and child; mapper runs after successful input take; input lifecycle failure remains inner TaskError. | Scheduling/state allocation; failure preserves input in error payload.

catalog.name: Task.observe
catalog.contract: Snapshot without consuming result; cannot provide an escaping borrowed T. | O(1); synchronized.

catalog.name: Task.open_scope
catalog.contract: Creates a compiler-tracked scope obligation; cannot escape storage it may borrow. | Registry allocation may fail.

catalog.name: Task.race
catalog.contract: Nonempty input; returns first terminal outcome plus owned handles for every unfinished loser. | Allocates bookkeeping; no automatic cancel.

catalog.name: Task.race_with_policy
catalog.contract: Nonempty input; named tie policy; unfinished losers returned as handles. | Bookkeeping allocation possible.

catalog.name: Task.ready
catalog.contract: Creates already-completed tracked task retaining value until taken or scope cleanup. | State allocation may fail.

catalog.name: Task.request_cancel
catalog.contract: Requests cooperative cancellation; outcome reports accepted/already-terminal/unsupported, never proves completion. | O(1) signal plus wake cost.

catalog.name: Task.request_scope_cancel
catalog.contract: Signals all registered children and propagating token descendants; does not drain them. | O(children) notifications possible.

catalog.name: Task.scope
catalog.contract: Body receives a lexical scope; all accepted children drained before returning; child failures reported by policy. | Allocates/tracks; explicit join boundary.

catalog.name: Task.scope_id
catalog.contract: Stable registry identity during scope lifetime. | O(1).

catalog.name: Task.scope_status
catalog.contract: Open, Closing or Drained snapshot; Drained proves no remaining scope loan use. | O(1).

catalog.name: Task.set_label
catalog.contract: Copies UTF-8 label explicitly; invalid state/allocation error; no borrowed dangling label. | O(label bytes); allocates.

catalog.name: Task.shutdown
catalog.contract: Closes admission, requests configured cancellation and drains tracked tasks; no unsafe forced release of borrowed work. | May wait indefinitely; fatal policy explicit.

catalog.name: Task.sleep
catalog.contract: Timer suspension; duration checked; no exact wake-up deadline guarantee. | Timer registration may allocate/fail.

catalog.name: Task.spawn
catalog.contract: Registers scoped captures before scheduling; accepts only lifetime/transfer-safe work. | Scheduling/allocation costs.

catalog.name: Task.spawn_blocking
catalog.contract: Blocking-pool execution; running work cannot be force-killed by cancellation. | May reserve worker/allocate.

catalog.name: Task.spawn_local
catalog.contract: Non-Send captures stay on compatible local executor and within scope lifetime. | Local scheduling; no migration.

catalog.name: Task.spawn_owned
catalog.contract: Owned captures move into the call and remain structured; failed registration safely destroys unstarted work/captures and releases their scoped loans. | May allocate and queue.

catalog.name: Task.status
catalog.contract: Observation snapshot of phase plus cancellation-request flag. | O(1) synchronized query.

catalog.name: Task.then
catalog.signature: Task.then<T, U>(&TaskScope scope, Task<T> input, OutcomeMapper<T, U> function)
catalog.contract: Mapper receives Result<T, TaskError> after input finishes; does not run before cleanup boundary. | May allocate; failure preserves consumed work handles.

catalog.name: Task.try_take
catalog.contract: Absent while running; present takes terminal success once; consumed handle reports Consumed. | Nonblocking synchronized operation.

catalog.name: Task.validate_captures
catalog.contract: Compile-time/diagnostic view of transfer and lifetime requirements; not a dynamic bypass. | Diagnostics; no scheduling.

catalog.name: Task.wait_deadline
catalog.contract: Observation only; expiry does not release captures or cancel task. | Timer scheduling cost.

catalog.name: Task.wait_timeout
catalog.contract: Ready or TimedOut observation; does not take T, cancel work or end its loans. | May block up to scheduler-dependent interval.

catalog.name: Task.yield_now
catalog.contract: Cooperative scheduling point; resumption and fairness not bounded. | Executor scheduling cost.

source_cancellation_checkpoint.scope: Nongeneric Task cancellation namespace and move-only source/token capabilities only.
source_cancellation_checkpoint.signature_difference: Token derivation and source/token clone are explicitly fallible Result operations, unlike conceptual nonfallible catalog signatures.
source_cancellation_checkpoint.evidence: Compiler e1fec8a4:5 positive groups across5 modes,11 negatives,112 injected-failure cases and96 AIR checks. No public source worker/Scope/spawn implementation is claimed.

version_scope.0.3: Synchronous thread-backed Task/Scope, blocking waits, cooperative cancellation, and the other CPU libraries remain in scope.
version_scope.0.4: Suspending Task APIs and their required async/await, coroutine, wake and timer machinery. A blocking wrapper is not an implementation of suspension.
version_scope.gpu: Deferred independently; not enabled by either CPU decision.

source_integration_checkpoint.native_backend: One native thread per admitted task; Executor.native_threads() is explicit.
source_integration_checkpoint.callables: Concrete zero-argument compiler closures satisfying sealed Send and transitive cleanup/effect validation. Fn, FnMut and FnOnce are accepted.
restrictions: Captured and returned values must be fully owned; scoped/static borrowed views are not admitted yet.
Task<T> retains a hidden Scope loan, including through carrier/container/helper paths.
Task and TaskScope, including wrappers, are prohibited in global/persist storage until shutdown ordering is proved.
Ordinary projected moves, including moving an owning field directly out of a closure capture, remain unsupported; this is not bypassed by Task.
Nested scopes, local executors, hierarchy, composition, detach and the remaining synchronous catalog contracts still require implementation.
source_integration_checkpoint.jit: Actual-source O0/O2 repeated-invocation, exact Drop and shutdown code-lifetime gate passed68checks and is included in120/120coherentcheckpointf46a65b2.
